name: LLFF Data Loading and Minification
aliases: LLFF Data Loading with ImageMagick Minification
definition: Loads LLFF dataset poses and images, optionally downscales images to a specified factor or resolution using ImageMagick.
summary: LLFF Data Loading and Minification prepares volume rendering datasets by downsampling images to one-eighth resolution and splitting data every eighth frame, adhering to the original LLFF paper conventions.
